name: Union Pharmacist Company For Medical Services And Investment
source: Mubasher (english.mubasher.info) EGX financial statements, annual section. Filed here under the exchange code UPM as well as UPMS: the EGX board carries both codes as separate rows for the same security (identical price, previous close, volume and turnover on the same session), and this statement was collected under UPMS only. The same figures are published under both codes so the financials panel resolves whichever code the reader opens. Issuer name on the filing: Union Pharmacist Company For Medical Services And Investment.
_unitNote: source page annual section is EGP thousand; stored absolute EGP (x1000)
source_note: Read from the Mubasher English-language EGX statement page, annual section (the source page labels the annual section "annual budget"). Mubasher prints that annual section in EGP thousand while the same page quarterly sections print the same figures 1000 times larger (measured quarterly to annual ratio 1080.6 on this company), so the annual figures are multiplied by 1000 here and stored in absolute EGP, the unit used by every other statement file in this dataset. Total Assets less Total Liabilities equals Total Equity for every period listed.
